name: Pin the Spears in the Lamb

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

target: 1 or more creatures that have shadows
text:
You manifest spikes to pin a creature's shadow to the ground, limiting their mobility. For each action you spend Casting this Spell, you can target one creature within range. Each target must attempt a Reflex save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The target is Immobilized for 1 round. An affected creature can escape its shadow's grasp with a check against your spell DC to end the effect.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is immobilized for 1 minute.
